freeze_rationale: The final bounded audit covered only candidates with a plausible capability gap or qualification-method contribution. Remaining work is implementation and behavior benchmarking, not ecosystem search.
unfreeze_condition: Only a critical security or functionality gap that none of PUBLIC_CORE or the frozen candidates can cover may reopen the pool, and that exception requires an author-visible V4.2 decision record.
